title: A Doll's House
author: Henrik Ibsen (tr. R. Farquharson Sharp)
license: Public domain in the USA; Project Gutenberg License applies to the file (trademark terms)
description: CONVERTED: no downloadable DOCX of a public-domain non-Shakespeare play was found, so Gutenberg's HTML was opened in Microsoft Word and saved as .docx (word_convert.ps1). Keeps the Gutenberg header, contents table, dramatis personae and licence. Each speech is one paragraph with the cue ('NORA.') and the speech separated by a soft line break; [bracketed] italic directions inline and as paragraphs; the opening direction spans two paragraphs; 'DOCTOR RANK.' once for 'RANK.'.
goldenMethod: gutenberg_dollshouse.py on the same HTML that was converted. verify.py: 1290/1292 >=95% verbatim in the DOCX text; spot-checked by hand.
sourceNote: sha256 is of the downloaded HTML; source.docx is Word's conversion
